summary: Marine Products Corp filed an 8-K Item 8.01 supplementing its definitive proxy statement regarding its pending acquisition by MasterCraft Boat Holdings. The transaction is structured as a two-step merger: first Merger Sub I merges into Marine Products, which survives as a wholly owned MasterCraft subsidiary, then merges into Merger Sub II. The parties entered the Agreement and Plan of Merger on February 5, 2026. A special stockholder meeting is set for May 12, 2026. Marine Products has received demand letters and two substantively identical complaints in New York Supreme Court alleging the proxy statement misrepresents or omits material information, seeking to enjoin or rescind the deal. The company denies allegations but provides supplemental disclosures. Watch for litigation outcome and stockholder vote as key risk-arb factors.
